description: Aeropuerto Internacional de Tocumen- Aerolíneas comerciales y de carga is a series of datasets listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Tocumen Aeropuerto Internacional de Panamá. Aerolíneas comerciales y de carga que operan mensualmente durante el 2021 en el Aeropuerto Internacional de Tocumen. Coverage: Panamá. The portal lists 7 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Tocumen Aeropuerto Internacional de Panamá. Its tags are aerolíneas carga, aerolíneas pasajeros, aviación, conectividad, pty. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2022-01-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
